sources.path: visual/index.html, visual/index.en.html, report/proposal.html, report/proposal.en.html, drawings/*, assets/figures/*
sources.usage: All brand figures, logos, palette and wayfinding symbols are original to this proposal; no third-party brand, portrait or image is embedded. All Chinese and Latin text is set in Noto Sans SC (Regular / Bold, version 2.004, SIL Open Font License 1.1), which permits commercial use, modification, redistribution and embedding. The four HTML files embed a per-page glyph subset of this typeface inline as base64 woff2: exactly two faces per page, declared explicitly as font-weight 400 (Regular) and 700 (Bold) so that CSS matches each face unambiguously and no glyph falls back to a system font. No remote font is loaded and no full font file is distributed. Figures, the A3 booklet and the A0 boards are rendered with the same typeface. The Heiti TC face previously used (macOS system-bundled, not redistributable) has been removed everywhere. Full asset-by-asset record: report/copyright_statement.md.

source_type_legend.official_public: Publicly published official document or webpage.
source_type_legend.repository_processed_reference: Repository processed navigation layer (not a new authority source).
source_type_legend.repository_maintainer_provisional: Provisional data provided by repository maintainers; usable for proposal generation and self-check, but NOT for official redline, approval basis, or precise area basis (see data/source_registry.json).
source_type_legend.user_provided_cleared: User-provided and rights-cleared material (e.g., agent taskbook).
source_type_legend.agent_inferred_from_public_data: Agent-derived inference from public data (not used in this submission; all boundary/key-area sources are repository_maintainer_provisional).
source_type_legend.conceptual_reference_pending_source_veri: Conceptual reference only, pending document-level source verification: publicly reachable but cited at portal/home-page level; cannot by itself substantiate a specific programme or policy claim, and is NOT a source-registry-approved formal source.
source_type_legend.original_or_system_bundled_or_open_licen: Original work, or system-bundled font used as an embedded per-page glyph subset with a documented OFL replacement path, or OFL-licensed open-source font.

clearance_status_legend.approved_formal: Document-level official source published by the issuing authority and registered as approved formal in the source-registry summary. In this package it applies to the official open-call announcement, the repository-provided cleared task materials, and the three national standards (GB 55019-2021, GB 50763-2012, GB 50180-2018). All entries in this package are registered at document_level_verified; no source is registered as conceptual_reference_pending_source_verification.
clearance_status_legend.conceptual_reference_pending_source_veri: Citational concept reference not yet verified at document level. May inspire design direction but must not be cited as evidence for a specific programme claim, and must not be described as source-registry-approved.
clearance_status_legend.document_level_verified: Document-level source: a specific page (not a portal home page) that was retrieved and read, with page title, publisher, publication/access date and a supporting passage recorded. Such a source may support the specific claim listed in its 'supports_claims' field and nothing beyond it.
